title: No One Will Take Your Joy Away

request.style: English, male baritone solo with backing choir, electric guitar, bass, drums, keys, hopeful and triumphant mood, 95 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Are you discussing among yourselves what I meant
A little while and you will not see me
Again a little while and you will see me
Truly truly I tell you this truth

[Pre-Chorus]
You will weep and mourn while the world rejoices
You will grieve but your grief will turn to joy

[Chorus]
Now you have grief but I will see you again
Your hearts will rejoice in the light
No one will take your joy away from you
Your joy is complete and bright

[Verse]
When a woman is in labor she has pain
Because her hour has come at last
But when she has given birth to the child
She no longer remembers the anguish

[Pre-Chorus]
Because of her joy that a child has been born
Into the world with such light
So it is with you in this moment
Now you have grief but I will see you again

[Chorus]
Now you have grief but I will see you again
Your hearts will rejoice in the light
No one will take your joy away from you
Your joy is complete and bright

[Bridge]
On that day you will not ask me anything
Whatever you ask the Father in my name
He will give you so your joy may be complete
I will tell you plainly about the Father

[Outro]
No one will take your joy away from you
No one will take your joy away
